name: Porto Airport (Francisco Sá Carneiro)

curfew.v: Take-off and landing banned by law 00:00–06:00 local (AIP: 00:00 (23:00)–06:00 (05:00)), except force majeure and a limited exception quota (11 daily, 70 weekly, 2,100 yearly); noisiest aircraft cannot be scheduled at night
curfew.quote: Landing and/or take-off is forbidden by law between 00:00 (23:00) and 06:00 (05:00), except in cases of force majeure.

slots.v: Airport slot mandatory for all flights (see GEN 1.2)
slots.quote: For Aerodrome Slot request see GEN 1.2 Mandatory for all flights.

handling.v: Handling 05:00–01:00; 01:00–05:00 on request. General aviation parks on remote stands with transport to the terminal

noise.v: Aircraft allowed to land at night must not use reverse thrust after landing
noise.quote: Aircraft authorised to land during the night period are strictly forbidden to reverse thrust right after landing;

notes: Read NAV Portugal eAIP AD 2 LPPR (current eAIP, valid from 01 Oct 2026; the page itself shows no date). Night ban 00:00–06:00 local: Portugal is UTC+0 in winter, and the bracketed times match local in summer. Night movements only within the government exception quota, with a slot. AD 2.20 lists handling agents (read, not quoted): Groundforce, OMNI Handling, Portway (full handling), Sky Valet (supervision), LGSP and Safeport Executive (passenger assistance). No de-icing listed.
